title: Joint Language Modeling for In-the-Wild Speech-Scene Generation with Distinct Token Representations
abstract: arXiv:2611.25503v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Speech-scene generation aims to synthesize intelligible target speech together with diverse environmental sounds as a coherent acoustic scene. The task is considered challenging in two respects. Speech and environmental audio differ substantially in their semantic and acoustic characteristics, yet existing approaches typically model the complete scene using a single mixed acoustic representation. At the same time, the two sounds are closely related in real-world speech scenes, whereas conventional approaches usually rely on simulated scenes mixed from independently recorded sources. We propose a large language model (LLM)-based framework for joint modeling of distinct speech and environment token streams. translated_title: 基于差异化Token表示的真实场景语音-声景生成联合语言建模
translated_abstract: 语音-声景生成旨在合成清晰可懂的目标语音，并将其与多样化的环境声音融合为一个连贯的声学场景。该任务在两个方面被认为具有挑战性：其一，语音与环境音频在语义和声学特性上差异显著，但现有方法通常使用单一的混合声学表示对完整场景进行建模；其二，在真实世界的语音场景中，这两种声音密切相关，而传统方法通常依赖于由独立录制音源混合而成的模拟场景。我们提出了一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的框架，用于对语音Token流与环境Token流这两条差异化Token流进行联合建模。其中，一个具备声源感知能力的神经音频编解码器从混合音频中提取时间对齐的语音Token与环境Token，预训练的LLM则以自然语言场景描述为条件，以交错方式生成这两条Token流。
tldr: 提出一种基于大语言模型的框架，利用声源感知的神经音频编解码器从真实场景混合音频中提取差异化对齐的语音与环境Token，并以交错方式联合生成两者，解决了语音与环境声建模混淆及依赖模拟混合数据的问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes an LLM-based framework that uses a source-aware neural audio codec to extract temporally aligned, distinct speech and environment tokens from mixed audio and generates both token streams in an interleaved manner for in-the-wild speech-scene generation.
